llm_c3_rank_xs.universe: top-200 by 30d median dollar volume, monthly PIT, 799-sym store
llm_c3_rank_xs.cadence: weekly (Friday cards), partition-rank-average batches of 25, R=2 rounds, temp 0, gpt-5.4-mini
llm_c3_rank_xs.anonymization: per-week random tags ASSET_NNN, 3-sig-digit rounding; named cards only for P1

holdout: 2026-07-01 — SEALED, virgin for this family, one-shot only if P3 passes

probes.P0_stability: 8 seeded weeks; identical-input rerun Spearman >=0.9; batch-order shuffle Spearman >=0.8; STOP else
probes.P1_anonymization: 52-week seeded subset named vs anon; named IC > 1.5x anon IC => memorization STOP; primary eval anonymous only
probes.P2_incremental: full anon dev run; weekly residualization on {vol rank, 4w momentum, size rank}; mean residual IC>0 with NW-t>=2.0 AND LLM residual IC >= LightGBM twin (walk-forward, identical features/targets); STOP on either
probes.P3_decile_ls: s43 harness, 5bp+funding: net SR>=0.8, dual-family placebo p<0.05, DSR>0.5 at declared n, >=3/4 subperiods nonneg

llm_c3_rank_xs.stop_rule: any STOP = dead this cycle; no prompt/field/frequency changes after P0 runs; holdout untouched until registered one-shot
